whenYouEarnDesc: You earn one-third (1/3rd) of your referral's first payment - a one-time reward, credited once that first payment is confirmed. Payments after the first do not generate further reward.
verificationDesc: A valid PAN and one government ID are required before any withdrawal. Payouts cannot be released until verification is complete.
taxTdsDesc: 2% TDS is deducted once your total earnings cross ₹20,000 in a financial year. Without a valid PAN, TDS is deducted at 20%. A Form 16A certificate is issued quarterly.
withdrawalsSettlementDesc: Withdrawal requests settle to your bank / UPI within 2–3 working days. A minimum withdrawal amount may apply.
reversalsDesc: If a referral's payment is refunded or reversed, the related reward may be held or recovered. The settlement window covers this check.
fullTermsDesc: Final legal copy goes here, add the reviewed policy text before launch.

taxCertificatesExpl: Form 16A shows the TDS deducted on your earnings. A certificate is issued each quarter once TDS applies (after you cross ₹20,000 in a year).
taxCertificatesFooter: Certificates generate after each quarter's TDS return is filed. Issued by Navicon InfraProjects Pvt. Ltd.
